response.sql:
WITH qualifying_patients AS (
  SELECT DISTINCT ID
  FROM Laboratory
  WHERE `U-PRO` = '-' AND RA = '-'
),
patient_averages AS (
  SELECT 
    ID,
    AVG(PT) AS avg_pt,
    AVG(TAT - TAT2) AS avg_tat_diff
  FROM Laboratory
  WHERE ID IN (SELECT ID FROM qualifying_patients)
  GROUP BY ID
)
SELECT 
  AVG(avg_pt) AS avg_pt_overall,
  AVG(avg_tat_diff) AS avg_tat_diff_overall
FROM patient_averages;

assumptions.assumption: "Ignore missing values at every step" is satisfied by SQL's AVG() function, which automatically excludes NULL values from average calculations at each stage (per-patient averages and overall averages)
